activationBasis: Nathan approved Yogi OTA source work only (relayed by Chief, 2026-11-05). No build, key, access, signing, publication, dispatch or phone action is authorized by this file. Publication and automation stay false until separately authorized.

builder.basis: Dedicated Yogi VM from the handoff: n2-standard-64, 2,000 GB SSD, last documented TERMINATED. It has no service account, GitHub runner or CI identity yet; status stays runner-unregistered until Infra registers the runner and the controller identity can get/start/stop only this instance. signing.basis: A Yogi-only OS key set; no other device's keys. The containers do not exist yet. Public pins (OTA certificate, AVB public key) exist only after the separately authorized bootstrap writes its receipt; nothing here claims them. Signing reads remain refused while status is not approved with an unexpired window.

labBaseline.reason: Established from the recorded artifact inspection: no packaged Updater, test-keys build tags, public AOSP development AVB and app identities. Not established: that the phone runs exactly this artifact (no installed-build readback), its installed OTA trust contents, and whether any sideload or data-preserving transition is possible. Proposed supported design: a one-time, separately authorized wipe installation of the Yogi bootstrap build (userdata and metadata erased), then in-place OTAs.

bootstrap.basis: Build A: the first Yogi-key image with the owned Updater, delivered as a private fastboot install image. Every published Yogi OTA must be newer than it and signed by the same Yogi identity.

allocationFloor.basis: Lab candidate identity; every allocated Yogi build number and BUILD_DATETIME is strictly greater.

appInputs.basis: One decision record, owned by Release: os/app-inputs/frankel-2026110403.json (schema roseos.app-inputs-record.v1, PR #565), committed by Release only after a separately authorized app-inputs-export run for Frankel 2026110403 (dev.pixel.voice 364, dev.pixel.calculator.agent 5, dev.pixel.backgroundcontrol 38; signer 650d47f9...0bfb). The Yogi job downloads exactly that record's run and artifact id, admits it with Release's scripts/app-inputs-verify.py verify (its own aapt/apksigner), then re-runs its own admission. Never signed on the Yogi builder. Bootstrap A and OTA B use the same set. Unbound (the guard refuses) until Release commits that record on main; Yogi commits no export fields. The 14-day artifact window starts at the export: bootstrap A and OTA B must both download within it, or Release re-exports and commits a new record.
